title: Clinical Study on Circadian Genes Dysregulation in Patients With Glucocorticoid Disorders
official: Clinical Study on Circadian Genes Dysregulation in Patients With Glucocorticoid Disorders
summary: This is a multicentric, prospective, intervention study on circadian genes expression in peripheral blood mononuclear cells as biomarkers of circadian rhythm derangement in patients affected by alterations of endogenous glucocorticoids secretion (Cushing's Syndrome during active phase, treatment and under remission and newly or on established glucocorticoid replacement therapy adrenal insufficiency)

sites.f: Department of Experimental Medicine, "Sapienza" University of Rome
